preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 100,000 inclusive, representing the length of string s.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: s is a lowercase English letter string of length n.
m is an integer between 1 and n inclusive, representing the length of string t.

preconditions.expression: len(t) == m and all(c.islower() for c in t)
preconditions.description: t is a lowercase English letter string of length m.
x is an integer between 1 and 30 inclusive, representing the maximum allowed number of pieces.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if any(all(t[i:i+len(sub)] == sub for i, sub in enumerate(substrings)) and len(substrings) <= x for substrings in find_substrings(s, t)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a way to select non-overlapping substrings from s in order such that their concatenation equals t and the number of substrings is at most x; otherwise output 'NO'.
